explain.title: How this is worked out
explain.base: From your last sync: {{currency}} currency in hand, {{chests}} chests claimed, {{shards}} shards, {{points}} points

howPoints.title: How points work
howPoints.body: Each battle you win scores its kill points. Every objective your team meets in that battle adds its score, and clearing all enemies adds the defeat-all bonus. A battle only counts once at its best: replaying it scores only the points above your previous high score.

leaderboard.title: Eligibility leaderboard
leaderboard.noEligible: No unit can play in this lane.
leaderboard.noUnlocked: None of your unlocked units can play in this lane.
leaderboard.rosterNotSynced: Your roster hasn't synced yet, so ownership, rarity and rank aren't shown.
leaderboard.progressUnavailable: Synced progress unavailable, so nothing counts as scored.

progress.title: Synced progress
progress.noEvent: No synced progress for this event yet.

howPoints.title: How points work
howPoints.body: Each battle's earned points are its high score plus the score of every objective you cleared in it, including the defeat-all bonus. A battle's maximum adds its kill score, its high score, the defeat-all bonus and every objective's score; the lane maximum adds every battle.

legend.title: Marks
legend.maybeClear: Maybe clear: worth a try if the team gets that far.
legend.stopHere: Stop here: not worth your tokens.
legend.note: Marks are reminders only: they never change points and disappear once sync shows the objective cleared.

toasts.error: Your marks could not be saved.

teams.notCovered: Not covered by the current members

editor.noCoverage: These members share no objective. The team still scores kill points.

editor.notSaved: Your plan was reloaded, so this team was not saved. Check it and save again.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.description: The team and its clear depths are removed from this event's plan.

active.title: The running event
active.content: The Legendary Event that is live right now, with its run, tokens and points from your last sync. Select it to open the event.

noActive.title: Nothing running
noActive.content: No Legendary Event is live right now. Upcoming events below show when the next run starts.

upcoming.title: Upcoming events
upcoming.content: Events that start next, soonest first, with their local start time. Events without an announced date are listed last.

tabs.title: Overview and lanes
tabs.content: Overview sums up the event; Alpha, Beta and Gamma open one lane each. On a phone the strip stays under the header while you scroll.

nextToken.title: Next token
nextToken.content: The battle to play with your next token: the team, lane and battle worth the most points now, from your sync, teams, depths and marks. If it didn't go to plan, mark it Partly cleared or Couldn't clear and the plan updates.

runStatus.title: Run status
runStatus.content: Your run, tokens, points, currency, chests and shards from your last sync, plus the next points milestone.

runInputs.title: Run inputs
runInputs.content: Enter the missions and packs the game does not report for each run. They feed the reward outlook on this card.

tokenPlan.title: Token plan
tokenPlan.content: Every token the plan expects to play in order, with running points and the milestones it crosses. The run forecast below spreads it across the remaining runs.

laneSummary.title: Lane summary
laneSummary.content: Each lane's points earned against its maximum and how many battles you have fully cleared. Pick a lane to jump to its progress grid.

overviewLeaderboard.title: Eligibility across lanes
overviewLeaderboard.content: Every unit that can play, with the points it can still score in each lane. Filter by objective, show only unlocked units, or switch to points per battle.

laneOverview.title: Lane overview
laneOverview.content: The lane's allowed units, kill points, five objectives with their scores and the points every battle is worth.

teams.title: Teams
teams.content: Build the teams you plan to play on this lane. Each card shows its members, the objectives they cover, its points per battle and how deep it should clear: an estimate from your synced roster until you set a depth yourself. Use Add team to start one.

progressGrid.title: Synced progress
progressGrid.content: Your cleared objectives and points per battle from your last sync, with the lane's points earned against its maximum. Mark an objective you have not cleared as Maybe clear or Stop here, or a whole battle from its row action.

leaderboard.title: Lane leaderboard
leaderboard.content: Every unit this lane allows, whether you own it, which objectives it meets and the points it can still score here.

estimates.uncalibrated: Uncalibrated: the estimate's power ratio has not been fitted to real clears yet, so treat it as a rough guide.
estimates.howItWorks: Estimated from your synced roster's combat power against each battle's power. Equipment, synergy and hard objectives aren't modelled; set a depth to override it.
